card.name: "It is" before unclear in JAK warning
card.fires_on: The word "is" in the phrase "Based on available data, it is unclear that the risk for CV thrombotic events...". This appears in the boxed warning about thrombosis in JAK inhibitor labels.

modes.label: It is unclear that
modes.description: The word "is" right after "Based on available data, it", just before "unclear that the risk for CV thrombotic events".
modes.example: which can be fatal. Based on available data, it<< is>> unclear that the risk for CV thrombot

card.writes: It slightly favors words like reasonable, routine and unlawful after "is", which suggests a judgment-style adjective comes next.
card.plain: It marks the word "is" in the standard label sentence saying it is unclear whether the clotting risk applies.
